List video categories. Use this tool to list available video categories.

Usage:
  yutu videoCategory list [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help                help for list
  -l, --hl string           Host language
  -i, --ids strings         IDs of the video categories
  -o, --output string       json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings       Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet])
  -r, --regionCode string   Region code (default "US")
